messages:
lina: ZetaCorp request: can we stack POC credits across 3 parallel POCs and then consolidate into a single commit if they convert within 90 days?
marco: Stacking is possible but hinges on billing entity. If the POCs live under one billing account, we can aggregate. Separate legal entities = separate treatment.
kate: Deal Desk stance: we can offer consolidated commit but require explicit SOW mapping. Proposal: define BILLING_ENTITY in SOW, tag each POC, cap stacking to a limit (default 2) unless Deal Desk approves exception.
sam: Note technical impact: different models and instance types mean per-token costs vary. Must include model multipliers or per-POC SKUs in quote.
jess: RevOps here 12: if they want zero charge during POC, we prefer metered+credited (tag usage as POC and apply credits after) so we keep telemetry. If they insist on invisible metering, that complicates capacity planning.
lina: Customer asks for 90-day conversion window and credits reserved until then. Is 90d operationally OK?
kate: Yes, 90d is acceptable. Terms to add: credits expire after 90d; credits are non-transferable across billing entities; stacking limit = 2 active POCs per billing entity without Deal Desk approval.
marco: Ops note: shared infra (same project/endpoints) could yield shared KV/cache benefits; combined cost may be lower than sum of individual estimates. We'll add a disclosure in the quote.
lina: I'll include a sentence: "Shared infra optimizations may affect per-POC cost assumptions."
jess: For RevOps import, provide CSV with columns: BILLING_ENTITY, POC_TAG, START_TS, END_TS, COMMIT_ID. Ops can import to mark credits.
ops-bot: /deal-request required with SOW + CSV. Use template: https://confluence.redwood/poc-commit-matrix (internal).
kate: Example SOW snippet to use (draft):
```
BILLING_ENTITY=ZetaCorp-Holdings
POC_TAG=ZETA-POC-2026-03
POC_WINDOW=2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30
POC_CREDIT=100% of usage for POC window, up to $30,000 per POC
CONSOLIDATED_COMMIT=Apply up to $60,000/mo for 12 months if signed within 90d
CREDIT_EXPIRATION=90d
STACKING_LIMIT=2 active POCs per billing entity without Deal Desk approval
```
kate: We'll route Deal Desk request to Legal for final language.
legal-bot: Legal: credits should be timeboxed and applied to future invoices; no refunds for committed fees. Include audit clause and usage validation.
marco: Also flag: if they want different SLAs or Dedicated capacity for POC, pricing on POC should reflect that.
lina: Understood. I'll attach CSV and estimated traffic profiles to the deal-request. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
